Title: Need to impress upon Government of Andhra Pradesh to stop construction of check dams on Palar and Kosastalaiyar rivers. 

SHRI G. HARI (ARAKKONAM): Government of Andhra Pradesh is constructing check dam across Kosasthalaiyar at Nelavayal Village and also across Palar river in Kuppam. Because of construction of these check dams, flow of water from these rivers to Tamil Nadu will be completely wiped out and entire water will be diverted to Andhra Pradesh. The Kusa is a sub tributary of interstate river Kosasthaliyar and supports an ayacut of about 354.32 acres fed by Veligaram tank in Tamil Nadu. Unilateral construction of check dam in Kuppam across river Palar will affect farmers of Vellore, Thiruvallur, Kancheepuram, Chennai as well as create scarcity of drinking water in these areas. Similarly, unilateral construction of check dam across Kosastalaiyar at Nelavayal will affect farmers in many villages in Tirutani Assembly Constituency which is part of my Arakonam Parliamentary constituency. I request the Government to urge upon the Andhra Pradesh Government to forthwith stop construction of check dams across these rivers.

Title: Need to set up AIIMS at Perundurai in Erode district of Tamil Nadu. 

SHRIMATI V. SATHYABAMA (TIRUPPUR): The Union Government had announced in its last Budget that AIIMS will be established in Tamil Nadu. The former Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu had immediately identified 5 suitable locations in Tamil Nadu including Perundurai in Erode District. The Central team had inspected the proposed locations in April last year. But the Union Government has yet to announce the location for the establishment of AIIMS in Tamil Nadu. The Former Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu had already urged the Hon'ble Prime Minister to ensure establishment of AIIMS Hospital in Tamil Nadu without any delay. 

The IRT- Perundurai Medical College and Hospital, Perundurai is located in a lush green landscape of 327 acres which is 20 Kms west of Erode Coimbatore Highway. The existing site inspected is easily approachable as it lies on the National Highway No. 47, connecting Coimbatore, Salem and Perundurai towns and is well connected with both train and bus services which provides better accessibility for patients. 

The AIIMS Hospital, if constructed at Perundurai, will provide medical care to around 2 crore people not only in the western districts of Tamil Nadu but also to the poor people in the adjoining States of Kerala and Karnataka. With the rising demand for medical care, there is a huge expectation for the establishment of AIIMS like Medical and Research Institution in Perundurai to provide best medical facilities and services to the people of this Kongu region. 

Therefore, I urge the Union Government to expedite the announcement of setting up of AIIMS at Perundurai in Erode district in Tamil Nadu and to ensure that the construction and establishment of AIIMS is initiated without any further delay.

श्री गजानन कीर्तिकर (मुम्बई उत्तर पश्चिम) ः यह सभी जानते हैं कि पश्चिम म्यांमार से गैर कानूनी तरीके से भारत में घुसपैठ करते हुए हजारों की संख्या में रोहिंग्या लोग कश्मीर के साथ ही देश के कुछ भागों में आकर बसे हैं और निरन्तर बस रहे हैं। वर्तमान में कश्मीर की अशांतमय स्थिति को देखते हुए रोहिंग्या लोग भी काफी प्रमाण में जिम्मेदार हो सकते हैं, इसके कुछ प्रमाण भी मिले हैं। गैर कानूनी तरीके से रहने के कारण भविष्य में इनसे भारत की एकता एवं अखंडता के खतरे में पड़ने की आशंका को टाला नहीं जा सकता। भारत सरकार को इसकी जानकारी रहते हुए भी रोहिंग्या लोगों को भारत में अवैध रूप से कैसे घुसने दिया गया, यह चिंता की बात है। दुश्मन देश इन रोहिंग्या लोगों का भारत में आतंक फैलाने में भी सहायता ले रहा है। ऐसा पाया गया है कि कुछ रोहिंग्या लोगों को आधार कार्ड व पैन कार्ड जैसी सुविधा भी कुछ भ्रष्ट अधिकारियों द्वारा रिश्वत लेकर प्रदान की गई। जानकारी है कि भारत सरकार इस प्रकरण पर सख्त कदम उठाने वाली है, लेकिन कब? मेरी सरकार से मांग है कि सरकार को भारत में गैर कानूनी तरीके से रह रहे रोहिंग्या लोगों की पहचान करते हुए उनको उनके देश तुरंत वापस भेजना चाहिए और म्यांमार-भारत की सीमा को मजबूत किया जाये जिससे आगे कोई खुली सीमा से भारत में प्रवेश न कर पाये।

Title: Regarding conferring Bharat Ratna on Nandamuri Taraka Rama Rao, the former Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh. 

SHRI KESINENI SRINIVAS (VIJAYAWADA): I represent the desire of the people of Andhra Pradesh regarding our former Chief Minister, Shri Nandamuri Taraka Rama Rao. He was the founder of our party, the Telugu Desam Party, and one of the greatest Chief Ministers of our state. 

He launched our party in 1982 and created a record by coming to power in Andhra Pradesh within nine months. As Chief Minister, he championed anti-corruption and social justice principles. He introduced multiple schemes for the disadvantaged sections of society and provided women equal rights to inheritance. He overhauled the state education and healthcare systems and invested in infrastructure for electricity, irrigation and housing and laid the foundation of Andhra Pradesh’s development. 

Given his multiple achievements and his dedication to the Telugu people, I urge the Government of India on behalf of the Telugu people to confer Bharat Ratna, the country’s highest civilian award on 
 Shri Nandamuri Taraka Rama Rao.

Title: Need to establish Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas in each district of Telangana. 

SHRI KOTHA PRABHAKAR REDDY (MEDAK): I would like to draw the attention of the Hon’ble Minister for Human Resource Development regarding need to sanction additional/new Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas in Telangana State. 

Navodaya schools had been established for the purpose of quality education and to promote national integration amongst the student community. These Centre funded schools are running successfully in every district of the country. 

Government is aware that in Telangana, there are 9 Navodaya Schools. As the Telangana government recognised and increased the number of districts to 31, the Navodaya Schools got confined to 9 districts only. To balance the regional disparities, Navodaya Schools should be established in all the districts. In view of the increased districts, the number of schools should be increased in other districts also to provide quality education to the people. These centrally funded and administered schools can act as model schools and they can give guidance and quality education to other schools in each district. 

I therefore urge upon Hon’ble Minister for Human Resource Development for establishment of Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas in each district of Telangana at the earliest.

Title: Need to take steps to check human-wildlife conflict in Kerala. 

ADV. JOICE GEORGE (IDUKKI): Human-wildlife conflict (HWC) has attracted greater attention in recent days in Kerala due to the straying of wild animals in the crop fields and also causing human casualties. Crop damage by wild animals is one of the major problems faced by the marginal farmers in Kerala. Wild pig, Asian elephant, Indian porcupine and sambar were the major crop raiders recorded in the homesteads and plantations, Places like.

Places like Chinnakkanal, Bisonvalley, Marayoor, Kuttampuzha, Mankulam etc. in my constituency are gripped with elephant attacks with human causalities too. Hence, I urge upon the Government to conduct carrying capacity studies and contain wildlife below carrying capacity and excess must be culled out. The legal protection of wildlife shall be strictly restricted to forest only. The crops as well as the human life should be insured and adequate compensation should be given to the victims on time. Fatal accident scheme should be given to the victims.
